scope: Explicit capture of referenced artifact objects and offline local restoration using existing provider adapters; local file/SQLite recovery and actual boto3 against a synthetic HTTP service.
implemented: Explicit include_remote_artifacts / --include-remote-artifacts opt-in preserves the existing stopped-writer and default no-provider-read behavior.

Validates profiles, immutable checksums/sizes and total limits before constructing stores. Captures only current/historical referenced objects, including archived versions, with deduplicated reads and no bucket listing or remote writes.
Built-in filesystem/S3/GCS/Azure stores implement bounded reads. Existing get-only custom stores remain compatible with post-read validation.

Versioned optional remote_artifacts manifest covers every captured object and original metadata. Verification stays offline and fails before restore for incomplete, conflicting, redirected or corrupt inventory.

Restore localizes staged current/history artifact records while retaining IDs, revisions, owners, archive flags and citation references. Active storage becomes local; remote profiles need a fresh probe before activation.

File and logical SQL restore share localization. Source workspace/namespace and remote objects remain unchanged; no queue rows are re-enqueued. A restored workspace can be backed up again without remote credentials.
Failure and interruption during capture publish no partial destination. Credential-bearing SDK exceptions stay out of messages.
Two installed-dependency skips in artifact-store tests were replaced with deterministic import/credential checks.

provider_evidence.s3: Actual boto3 GetObject over local Postman simulation: two revisions captured and restored offline; 404, 403, 503, changed bytes and oversized content fail publication.
provider_evidence.gcs: Local injected store lifecycle plus metadata/range/generation call-contract tests; actual SDK runtime not installed in this test environment.
provider_evidence.azure: Local injected store lifecycle plus metadata/range call-contract tests; actual SDK runtime not installed in this test environment.
provider_evidence.filesystem: Real bytes, bounded reads, explicit nondefault-store CLI capture and offline restore.

simulation.note: S3 SDK retried read-only 503 responses. No mutating operation or bucket-list call occurred. Local simulation stopped afterward.

migration: Additive optional v1 snapshot inventory and get_bounded store capability; no production state rewrite. Restore rewrites staged references only. Prior local snapshots remain readable; older recovery tools reject remote snapshots safely. Source records/backups remain the rollback copy.

static.existing_test_naming_findings: Pre-existing N803 names mirror boto3 keyword names in old fake-client methods; no new naming findings.

validation_pending: Actual GCS/Azure SDK runtime acceptance and selected live S3/GCS/Azure permissions, retention/history and restore checks.
Real PostgreSQL state/restore, personal HTTPS VM and existing authentication/account-store disaster recovery.
